game.title: Sniper Elite 5
game.blurb: Third-person stealth sniping game set in 1944 France, from Rebellion, released 2022-05-25. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: From the Atlantic Wall to Desponts-sur-Douve, the hidden story milestones, optional objectives and the Authentic run. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Mission Feats and Möller
chapters.summary: Taking down Möller in special ways, the Martressac train, the bridge snipers, Secret Weapons and St Nazaire.

chapters.title: Letters, Documents and Hidden Items
chapters.summary: Personal letters, classified documents, Hidden Items, Dead-eye Targets and workbenches.

chapters.title: Weapons, Kills and Rank
chapters.summary: Kill counts by weapon, mastery medals, ghost kills, takedowns, traps, long shots and reaching rank 40.

chapters.title: Landing Force, Conqueror, Rough Landing and Kraken Awakes
chapters.summary: Four further campaign missions, each with 2-star and Authentic goals.

chapters.title: Wolf Mountain
chapters.summary: The Wolf Mountain mission and its target challenges.

chapters.title: Axis Invasion, PvP and Survival
chapters.summary: Invading and defending in Axis Invasion, team PvP matches and survival missions. Needs a network connection.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Sniper Elite 5" or "Sniper Elite V". sniperelite.fandom.com answers the API, with about 100 linked articles, mostly weapons, vehicles and characters, plus mission pages such as "The Atlantic Wall", "Occupied Residence", "War Factory", "Secret Weapons", "Spy Academy", "Rubble And Ruin", "Loose Ends", "Libération", "Landing Force", "Conqueror", "Rough Landing", "Kraken Awakes" and "Target Führer - Wolf Mountain"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "New_Project_X" (a placeholder name); the store list confirms app 1029690. Only 3 of 71 Steam achievements are hidden ("Change the Channel", "Target America", "The Kraken Sleeps"); they sit among the story achievements in the Steam list and sit in the campaign chapter. Landing Force, Conqueror, Rough Landing and Kraken Awakes are called "campaign missions" by Steam but have low unlock rates (7 to 11%) and their own 2-star and Authentic achievements, so they have their own chapter; the data does not say whether they are paid add-ons. Wolf Mountain likewise has its own chapter. Axis Invasion, PvP and survival goals need a network connection.
